direct_file_reviews.summary: Prompt requires a clean-room reimplementation based only on normal CLI interaction with the provided executable and bundled docs.
Parallel metadata records actual parallel use, four covered rollouts, completed evaluation, and failed solution quality.
Official status records parallel mode, subagent activity, artifact members including probe files, and compile_failed evaluation with 0 of 2080 tests.
Evaluation summary confirms completed ProgramBench evaluation, compile_failed error code, and no tests run.

timeline_reviews.summary: Transport mirror of the parallel run showing the parent probing README/help, spawning children, running CLI examples, and ending on a 429.

Parent trajectory spawned docs_reader and cli_probe, tried additional probe children that hit the thread limit, ran basic CLI probes, received a child error, and ended on a 429 without writing source.
Docs child repeated workspace discovery, README and help inspection, attempted another cli_probe spawn that failed due thread limit, and ended with a 429 instead of a useful completed handoff.
CLI child probed help, transformations, file and language behavior, wrote sample fixtures into /workspace/probe, spawned a nested docs child, and was interrupted before final return.
Nested docs child read README and LICENSE, produced line-numbered documentation evidence, then was interrupted before a final result could be consumed.

direct_file_reviews.summary: Prompt is byte-identical to the parallel prompt and requires clean-room CLI observation rather than source recovery or wrapping.
Serial metadata records no parallel use, one covered rollout, completed evaluation, and failed solution quality.
Official status records serial mode with no subagents, artifact members without probe files, and compile_failed evaluation with 0 of 2080 tests.
Evaluation summary confirms completed ProgramBench evaluation, compile_failed error code, and no tests run.

timeline_reviews.summary: Transport mirror of the serial run showing one parent trajectory with workspace inspection, CLI probing, fixture experiments, and final 429.

Single-agent raw trajectory read docs, probed help/version, transformations, file globbing, dry-run, hidden/gitignored behavior, fail flags, symbols, and German rules, but never wrote a replacement before 429.

parallel.requirements: The run recognized the clean-room reverse-engineering task, the prohibition on source recovery or wrapping, and the need to reproduce an srgn-style CLI from README and executable behavior.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent split early discovery among itself, a docs_reader child, a cli_probe child, and a nested docs_probe child; implementation remained implicitly with the parent after probing.
parallel.implementation: No new source code, build file, or replacement executable implementation was created. The run only read docs, probed CLI/help behavior, and created probe fixtures.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: No implementation was integrated. The packed artifact still contained the initial workspace plus child-created probe/sample files, and artifact validation failed.
parallel.verification: Verification consisted only of black-box probes against the provided executable. There was no verification of a newly built replacement.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The attempt ended on a 429 before implementation, left child probe work interrupted, leaked probe fixtures into the artifact, and officially failed compilation with 0 of 2080 tests run.

serial.requirements: The run recognized the clean-room reverse-engineering task, read the same bundled documentation, and treated the executable's observed CLI as source of truth.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single parent owned discovery, implementation planning, and eventual build work; no subagents or parallel delegation were used.
serial.implementation: No replacement source or build script was written. The run focused on increasingly detailed CLI, file, language, and transformation probes.
serial.integration_and_delivery: No new implementation was assembled or delivered. The artifact contained the starting workspace files without the parallel run's extra probe directory.
serial.verification: The serial run gathered more black-box behavioral evidence, including file-mode and transformation cases, but did not verify any new executable.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The attempt also ended on a 429 before code generation, so the official evaluator failed at compile time with 0 of 2080 tests run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the clean-room task and probed the README plus executable behavior as the task allowed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same clean-room task and also treated the executable's observed behavior as authoritative.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There is no material requirement-recognition split; both saw the same srgn CLI target, but neither reached implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed discovery into docs and CLI probing children while the parent also probed and attempted more probe children.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept all discovery and future implementation responsibility in one parent trajectory with a local todo plan.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel split created child lifecycle and shared-workspace boundaries; serial avoided those boundaries but still overran before coding.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child task payloads are encrypted, but the observable handoff state shows one error handoff and interrupted children rather than a consolidated implementation brief.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial retained observations in one context and did not depend on cross-agent handoffs or interfaces.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The concrete context difference is lifecycle rather than a missing interface contract: parallel child findings did not all return to the parent.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel stayed in probing: README/help, baseline replacements, toolchain checks, and child fixture probes; it wrote no replacement source.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also wrote no replacement source, but it covered more behavioral probes before ending, including file mode, hidden/gitignored handling, fail flags, symbols, and German rules.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial gathered a broader behavioral map, while parallel stopped earlier with no implementation and extra workspace probe files.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had child results fail or get interrupted: docs_reader returned an error, and cli_probe plus nested docs_probe were aborted before final answers.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; all observations were generated in the same parent trajectory until the final 429.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel lost child work at a coordination boundary, while serial's equivalent probe evidence remained directly in the parent context.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: A child created /workspace/probe/sample.py and sample.txt in the shared final workspace, and those files appeared in the packed artifact.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial created comparable probe fixtures under /tmp and its artifact list did not contain a probe directory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel contaminated the final tree with exploratory child artifacts; serial kept probes outside the submitted workspace.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel only verified observed behavior of the provided executable and never ran checks against a replacement; official tests were not run after compile failure.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial likewise verified only black-box observations of the provided executable and never reached replacement verification; official tests were not run after compile failure.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial gathered broader preimplementation observations, but neither mode produced acceptance evidence for a new executable.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ended after about 75 seconds on a 429 with active or failed child work and no implementation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ended after about 201 seconds on a 429 after a longer single-threaded probing sequence and no implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel closed earlier and with unresolved child lifecycle side effects, while serial closed later from the same provider failure class.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluations show both modes failed compilation with 0 of 2080 tests run, so there is no discordant official outcome to explain. The concrete task-solving difference is procedural: parallel spread discovery across child agents, left child work interrupted, and leaked probe files into the artifact; serial stayed in one context and probed more behavior but still never wrote a replacement implementation.
parallel_contributors: Parallel child probing was interrupted before completed handoffs were available to the parent.
A child wrote exploratory probe files into /workspace and those files were packed into the artifact.
serial_contributors: Serial gathered broader CLI and file-mode observations in one parent context.
Serial nevertheless failed because it also ended before generating a clean-room implementation.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Neither run wrote source code or a buildable replacement executable.
Serial's additional black-box probes did not translate into implementation before closure.
evaluator_effects: Both official evaluations stopped at compile_failed, so no behavioral tests ran.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained patterns are realized parallel-side adverse effects, not an exclusive root cause for the official result

candidates.reason: The parent implicitly retained implementation responsibility after probing; failure came before implementation rather than from an unassigned implementer.
No multiple component implementations existed, so there was no concrete integration object without an owner.
No complete implementation candidate was ready for final assembly or packaging as a deliverable.
The run never reached a multi-stage implementation/build/test pipeline where an end-to-end transition was unowned.
There was no single mandatory preflight or oracle step gating all productive work; multiple probes ran concurrently.
Although the run stayed in investigation, the direct retained lifecycle problem is interrupted child work, and the investigation phase never cleanly completed before implementation.
Implementation was delayed, but the more direct evidence is child interruption and artifact leakage rather than a proven capacity starvation episode.
Thread-limit failures and a 429 are visible, but high fan-out and provider failure alone do not prove a time or token budget exhaustion episode independent of the retained interruption chain.
No single child has an observable overbroad assignment that uniquely left indispensable implementation work unfinished.
The child payloads are encrypted, and no child is shown following an absent known requirement into unusable implementation work.
Children were assigned discovery/probing, not separately owned interoperating implementation components with a missing contract.
No known finding is shown disappearing through a summary or transfer; the relevant problem is missing final child return.
No large returned handoff reached the parent and then went materially unconsumed because of volume or poor structure.
No receiver consumed a handoff describing a superseded workspace, requirement, dependency, or decision state.
No incompatible child reports or contracts reached the parent and remained unadjudicated at an integration decision.
The parent did not accept or present the whole task as complete; the run ended with an agent error.
There was no replacement or retry agent that repeated prior work without inherited findings or workspace state.

taxonomy_decisions.sub_label: Wrong Start, Join, or Result Timing

candidates.reason: The parent delegated CLI probing to a child, the child produced relevant file/language observations, and the child trajectory was explicitly interrupted before a completed final handoff reached the parent.
candidates.realized_consequence: Useful CLI/file-scope observations stayed in an interrupted child trajectory and were not delivered as a completed result before the parent closed.
candidates.near_match_reason: The child was explicitly interrupted before a normal failed-result handoff; treating the same terminal chain as a separate takeover failure would duplicate the episode.

candidates.reason: No complete, promotable implementation candidate or mutually compatible component set existed before closure.
No child result or implementation change was merged after verification, and no replacement verification occurred.
No delegated implementation was completed or retrievable for the parent to adopt into the final solution.
No verifier child produced a concrete finding that was trapped below the parent before closure.
A child error and interruptions are visible, but there is no independent takeover episode beyond the retained early-termination chain.
The parent received an error notification from docs_reader, not a concrete completed useful result that it ignored at a decision point.
The parent and children actively probed the executable; the terminal 429 was not a passive wait through available progress.
No concurrent agents wrote competing implementation files or overlapping component designs that required reconciliation.
No two live agents edited the same file with one observing or reconciling the other's concurrent change.
No non-entry source or configuration owned by another agent was replaced or wholesale rewritten.
The required executable or submitted entry point was not overwritten by another live agent.
No broad cleanup, rebuild, or promotion replaced multiple current outputs in the final workspace.
The child did write in the shared workspace, but the more specific observed consequence is temporary artifact leakage into the submission.
A parallel child generated probe/sample fixtures in /workspace/probe and the final artifact manifest packaged those child-created files into the submission.
candidates.realized_consequence: The submitted parallel artifact contained exploratory child probe files under ./probe, contaminating the final tree with non-solution material.
candidates.near_match_reason: The issue is not just unisolated shared writing; the realized and more specific effect is that generated fixtures leaked into the submitted artifact.
